description: Default capability for the bundled shell page: event listening (dsh-status, dsh-install-log), the IPC it needs to report status and trigger the install, and the window controls the self-drawn title bar depends on — the window is created with decorations(false), so dragging, minimize, maximize and close have no native affordance and must come from the page. Scoped to the `main` webview, not the whole window: the dsh GUI is a sibling child webview in that same window (see mount_gui), and it renders model output, so it must not be handed window control. Capabilities without a `remote` block do not apply to remote origins, so the dsh page could not reach these anyway — the webview scope makes that structural rather than incidental.
